facts.fact: Minecraft environments can contain snowy areas with unstable ground support that may require systematic exploration to find stable locations.
Minecraft environments can contain snowy areas with snow blocks that can be dug to collect snow resources.

tool_contracts.insight: Returns structured information including connection status, position coordinates, orientation (yaw/pitch), health, food level, and current action of the Minecraft bot.
Successfully delivers a message to the specified target (User) with the provided content.
Loads a note by name and makes its content available for use in subsequent steps.
Provides a summary of the blocks around the bot including directions, distances, and block types.
Returns information about items in the vicinity, including counts, types, and distances.
Performs reasoning based on provided input to evaluate or synthesize information.
Creates a persistent note with specified content for use in subsequent steps.
Moves the bot in specified directions for a given duration. Can fail with 'fell unexpectedly' when moving into gaps or holes, which may indicate cave entrances.
Systematically explores the environment by moving and observing blocks. Can run recursively and may exceed max_steps limit when used in certain contexts.
Successfully removes specified block and should cause it to drop as an item. Does not guarantee immediate item pickup detection.
